issues.description: version field is unquoted (version: 3.13.0). Rule 14 example shows version: "1.3.1" with double quotes. While YAML parsers treat 3.13.0 as a string, the project convention is to quote version values to prevent ambiguity with numeric types.

generated_at uses single quotes ('2026-08-07T08:29:47') instead of double quotes. Rule 13 specifies double quotes for YAML string values as project convention. Same pattern on lines 21 and 25 (guard: 'pending').
issues.fix_suggestion: Use double quotes consistently: generated_at: "2026-08-07T08:29:47", guard: "pending"

issues.description: guard field value is 'pending' for both patches, but the patches modify Makefile and lib/configure (shell script) — not C source files. C preprocessor guards (#ifdef __OHOS__) are not applicable to these patch types. Consider updating guard status to reflect non-applicability.
issues.fix_suggestion: Set guard to 'none' or 'n/a' for non-C-source patches, or document that 'pending' refers to a different review stage.

summary: Audit PASS. All P0 (deception) checks pass: (1) test.c is a real API test calling pci_alloc() (line 5), PCI_LIB_VERSION (line 10), and pci_cleanup() (line 12) — not a stub; (2) SHA256 is a valid 64-char hex (a03c88a0aab709b1697ca1753766f443e78297f84c7bcd80a82c1422edd7cb42), not all-zeros or all-f; (3) manifest status='built' is consistent with notes.md build results (G2 PASS, W3 PASS, G1-G4 gates pass); (4) no pre-compiled binaries in changed files; (5) test_package test() method actually runs the test binary (no pass/fake pass). All P1 (correctness) checks pass: (1) shared option properly wired to build() and package() via SHARED={shared_flag} (conanfile.py lines 40-41, 44-48); (2) source URL is official (https://mj.ucw.cz/download/linux/pci/pciutils-3.13.0.tar.gz — Martin Mares' official site); (3) self.run() uses env='conanbuild' and cwd=self.source_folder in both build() and package(); (4) commands.json follows standard schema (name, type=tool, versions with ref/binary); (5) no hardcoded local paths in manifest.yaml; (6) Conan 2.x API used correctly (from conan import ConanFile); (7) method order correct (export_sources→requirements→layout→source→generate→build→package→package_info); (8) patches have substantive adaptation logic (compiler change to clang, symlink→cp replacement, HarmonyOS→linux platform mapping — not empty stubs); (9) package_info sets cpp_info.libs=['pci'] and bindirs=['bin','sbin']. Three minor issues found: P2 (manifest.yaml version unquoted) and two P3 (YAML quoting inconsistency, guard field applicability for non-C patches).
